abstract:
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of carbon ion radiotherapy (CIRT) in patients with non-metastatic, inoperable pancreatic cancer in a prospective phase 2 setting.
METHODS: In this single-center investigator-initiated phase 2 trial, 25 patients with locally advanced or locally recurrent pancreatic cancer were included. CIRT was performed using an intensity-controlled rasterscanning system for beam application [total dose: 48 Gy (RBE), 12 fractions]. Concurrent chemotherapy with Gemcitabine 300 mg/m2 was administered weekly. The primary endpoint was the 1-year OS rate, defined as time from study inclusion. 1y- and 2y-OS and -PFS were calculated using the Kaplan-Meier method, 95 % confidence intervals are shown. Toxicity was evaluated using CTCAEv5.0.
RESULTS: Twenty-three patients were included in the final analysis. After the completed 12-month follow-up of the last patient, the 1- and 2-year OS rates were 78 % [CI 63 %; 97 %] and 59 % [CI 41 %; 84 %]. The median OS was 26.5 months. The 1- and 2-year PFS rates were 26 % [CI 13 %; 52 %] and 10 % [CI 3 %; 37 %] with a median PFS of 8.1 months. Study treatment was well tolerated with three treatment-related CTCAE grade 3 toxicities, including one case of abdominal pain, one upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage and one ureteric stricture. No treatment-related CTCAE grade 4-5 toxicities were observed.
CONCLUSION: Chemoradiation with carbon ions demonstrated encouraging overall survival and acceptable toxicity in non-metastatic pancreatic cancer patients. A subsequent randomized Phase 3 trial should investigate OS superiority of CIRT compared to conventional chemoradiotherapy or chemotherapy.
key_points_ko: 비전이성 췌장암 환자 23명에서 탄소이온 방사선치료 후 1년 및 2년 전체 생존율(OS)은 각각 78%와 59%였고 중앙 생존기간은 26.5개월이었습니다.
중앙 무진행 생존기간(PFS)은 8.1개월이었으며, 1년 및 2년 무진행 생존율은 각각 26%와 10%였습니다.
치료 관련 3등급 독성은 복통, 상부위장관 출혈, 요관 협착 각 1건(총 3건) 보고되었고 4등급 이상의 이상반응은 없었습니다.
summary_ko: 수술이 불가능한 비전이성 국소 진행성 또는 국소 재발 췌장암 환자 23명을 대상으로 탄소이온 방사선치료(CIRT)와 gemcitabine(젬시타빈) 병용 요법의 효과와 안전성을 평가한 전향적 2상 임상시험 결과입니다. 환자들은 총 48 Gy(RBE)의 탄소이온 방사선을 12회에 나누어 조사받았으며 매주 저용량 젬시타빈을 병용 투여받았습니다. 분석 결과 1년 전체 생존율은 78%, 중앙 생존기간은 26.5개월로 고무적인 생존 연장 효과를 보였습니다. 치료 관련 중증 부작용(3등급)은 복통, 상부위장관 출혈, 요관 협착 각 1건씩 발생하였으며 4등급 이상의 심각한 독성은 관찰되지 않아 내약성이 양호했습니다.
title: Carbon ion radiotherapy for non-metastatic pancreatic cancer: final results of the prospective phase 2 PACK-study (NCT04194268)
title_ko: 비전이성 췌장암 환자를 위한 탄소이온 방사선치료: 전향적 2상 PACK 임상시험 최종 결과
